# Copilot repository entry point

This file points Copilot to the shared entry point and methods. Humans and agents use the same methods, facts, and results.

## Start here

1. Read the root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first.
2. Use the [README activity navigation](../README.md#activities) to choose the matching `SKILL.md`, and read it in full.

## While working

- When changing Markdown, read the [documentation rules](instructions/docs.instructions.md).
- When changing any test, read the [test rules](instructions/tests.instructions.md), even if the file does not match the automatic rules.
- Links in methods are for navigation. They do not guarantee that target files are automatically included or loaded. When a target is not discovered, read it explicitly.

## Permissions

- Native client discovery, external execution, and permissions must still be verified in practice, each separately. For the distribution candidate scope and the boundaries that have not been run, see the [distribution guide](../docs/distribution.md).
- This file grants no additional operating permissions.
